_doc: THE EDGE PII-LOG BASELINE (A+ backend.3 / backend.6; LT36 car 2).
scripts/edgeLogGuard.mjs arm 2 (consolePiiValueOffenders) fails the edge gate on any
console.* call under supabase/functions/ that carries a PII VALUE — an interpolated or
bare identifier whose name resolves to an email / IP / user-agent, or a direct
The files listed below are GRANDFATHERED so the rule can be an ERROR for new offenders
from the moment it lands (backend.3's own ordering warning: 'Step 3 depends on Steps 1-2
being done or it fails red immediately'). This list is SHRINK-ONLY and EXACT: a new
offending file reds the gate, and a stale entry whose file was cured reds
tests/security/edgeLogRedaction.test.js. Both directions are pinned there.
`ceiling` is the total offending-call count across the listed files. It exists because a
file list alone is not occurrence-tight: a grandfathered file could grow a SECOND leak
without leaving the list. Lower it as sites are cured; never raise it.
TO CURE an entry: route the line through logSafe()/redact() in
supabase/functions/_shared/log.ts, masking any IP with maskIp(), then delete the entry
and lower `ceiling` in the same commit.

files._shared/requestMeta.ts: rejectObviousBot() logs `ip=${meta.ip} ua=${meta.ua.slice(0, 200)}` through a bare console.warn — this is A+ backend.6's named defect, cured by LT36 car 3.
files.send-email/index.ts: the cap_warning limiter logs `rate-limited ip=${ip}` through a bare console.warn — a SECOND instance of backend.6's class, found by this guard rather than by the record, cured by LT36 car 3.
